text:
sam: Heads-up: CVE-2026-1987 patch landed on main for the http-proxy dependency. We need to decide backport strategy for Dedicated + Private builds (some customers still on v1.12).
anjali: Do we know which Dedicated clusters run v1.12? I can query billing tags and env metadata.
kevin: @anjali there's at least 3 enterprise tenants pinned to 1.12 due to custom images. One is in a VPC with no outbound access.
maria: For the air-gapped tenant we'll need a signed image + an offline install bundle. Backport must land on the 1.12 branch and we should produce a TLS-signed release artifact.
sam: Agreed. Priority question: do we treat this as P0 for Dedicated/private? CVE seems exploitable in default config but requires unauthenticated path.
anjali: Based on initial triage it's medium-high. Exploit needs crafted upstream proxy headers; attack surface reduced in our Dedicated defaults (RBAC + ingress rules), but customers with permissive proxies are at risk.
kevin: Recommend: (1) backport fix to release-1.12 and release-1.13, (2) prepare hotfix images, (3) push advisory and mitigation steps for self-hosted customers.
lucy: Ops-bot: creating tickets
ops-bot: Created ticket: ENGSEC-6123 Backport CVE-2026-1987 to release-1.12 and 1.13 - https://redwood.internal/ENGSEC-6123
sam: For the branch workflow: do we cherry-pick the commit from main or re-implement minimal fix? The main has some refactor that won't apply cleanly.
anjali: Cherry-pick fails on 1.12 due to vendoring differences. Safer to port the minimal patch with tests.
maria: Tests: need unit + an integration scenario for an ingress passthrough with header tampering. Can we run the integration in the private-stage infra?
kevin: Private-stage is available but not in the same networking as customer VPCs. For the VPC/offline tenant we should produce an identical bundle and coordinate with their SRE to test in a mirror environment.
sam: KMS note: the hotfix image must preserve any KMS key id handling in our private images. We shouldn't rotate keys automatically in the release payload.
anjali: Good catch — the private deployment image must retain KMS config placeholders and not attempt to re-register keys on start. Add manual steps in the release notes.
lucy: Ops-bot: Created checklist item: "Verify KMS config stays intact in private builds" on ENGSEC-6123
ops-bot: Added comment on ENGSEC-6123: @platform-team review required for image signing process.
maria: Audit logging: we should add an instrumentation point to log attempted header-mutate events (security-level audit) so customers can detect exploitation attempts.
kevin: That would be a code change; we could include it as a soft enhancement in 1.13 and ship backport only for the patch. Keep audit logging off for 1.12 hotfix unless trivial.
sam: Communication plan: publish CVE advisory and immediate mitigations (config snippet to tighten ingress rules, quick WAF rule, disable the vulnerable header). Then announce availability of hotfix images and offline bundles.
anjali: I'll draft the advisory. Can we include a script to validate a cluster is not vulnerable? e.g., curl-based test against the proxy behavior.
maria: Yes. I'll add a small validation script and a sample kubejob to run on Dedicated clusters.
kevin: Who's owning the backport PRs? I can take release-1.12, @sam takes 1.13, and @maria will do tests and images.
sam: Sounds good. Estimated timeline: backport + QA for 1.13 in 6 hours, 1.12 port + signed images in 12-18 hours depending on manual bundle signing.
anjali: I'll start notifying the affected customers with a pre-advisory and ask for available maintenance windows.
lucy: Ops-bot: Notifying customers list: CUST-194, CUST-201, CUST-233 via secure channel.
ops-bot: Ticket ENGSEC-6123 updated: owner assignments: release-1.12 -> kevin, release-1.13 -> sam, tests & bundles -> maria, advisory -> anjali.
sam: FYI: remember to bump SBOM and include dependency patch mapping for compliance teams.
maria: I'll attach SBOM and signed checksum files to the offline bundle.
kevin: One more: verify the private-deployment helm chart values don't override the patched package with pinned older version from customer-specific image layers.
anjali: Good point — ops checklist item added.
sam: Ok team — let's follow the checklist in ENGSEC-6123. If any blocker appears ping #oncall and escalate.
maria: Will do. Starting PRs now.
kevin: I'll begin building the signed images once the PR lands.
anjali: Draft advisory ready in comments, will iterate.
sam: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
